name: Jam Band
description: A band you lead with your voice: ask for drums, then bass, then the whole band - in swing, blues, rock, funk, disco, reggae, bossa or tango, in any key. Played by the device's MIDI instrument.
author: emkay-voice

ca-es.name: Banda de jam
